---
title: "Select papers to reference when needing a citation"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(DT)

csv <- read.csv("data/irss_articles.csv")

# csv$Title <- paste0("<a target =_blank href='",csv$Link,"'>",csv$Title,"</a>")

# names(csv) <- c("Topic", "Subtopic", "Author", "Year", "Type", "Title")

DT::datatable(csv, escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 15))
```

## Journals that IRSS members have published in

* [Scientific Journal Rank (SJR)](https://www.scimagojr.com/journalrank.php)

* [Journal H-index](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H-index)

* Number of IRSS publications in the journal

* Most recent IRSS publication in the journal (title, author, year)

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}

csv <- read.csv("data/irss_journals_summary.csv")

DT::datatable(csv, rownames = FALSE,extensions = 'FixedColumns', options = list(pageLength = 15,autowidth = TRUE))
```
